events.title: New Bosses
events.summary: Hello Gemfallers! The reign of the spider queen is at an end. This update brings two new bosses for you to challenge in Act 1 You will have to unlock them first; if you get lost, the details can be found in the compendium. Happy matching, @aqua_pi

events.title: The Compendium
events.summary: Introducing the compendium! You can now track all of the different skills, enchants, and relics found in the game. It will also show if you managed to beat the boss while using it.Coming soon will be another section, where we will introduce achievements.. Cheers,@aqua_pi

events.title: Run Summary and Feedback Submissions
events.summary: Two small changes in this update: Runs will now summarize your performance, and show your final build at the end. Send your screenshots to your friends! We also added a feedback page.Click on the new blue bug button in the top right (next to the inventory bag) to let us know anything and everything about the game. If you want, you can auto-attach a screenshot and/or your save game to help us track down the bug. If you want to give even more feedback, hop on over to our discord!Sincerely@aqua_pi

events.title: Visuals Update
events.summary: The battle scene has just received a variety of graphical updates.Lighting: As gems the gems pop, there will be a burst of color, reflected on the player and enemies.Other subtle changes include: god rays, light fog, fireflies, and gem flight sparkles. The buff animation also got an update, fitting better within the style of our world. Many of the spells received a custom animation, making battles more lively. We hope you enjoy the new visuals! @aqua_pi
